All members of the regional swim league
Members of the regional league ages 14 to 17
Only the 90 swimmers who were selected
explanation: The 90 swimmers were picked at random from one group: league members ages 14 to 17. Because the selection was random, the results speak for that whole group. They don't reach any further. The correct choice keeps both qualifiers, the league and the age range.

A.why: You dropped the league. Swimmers outside the league could never have been chosen, so the sample tells you nothing about them, even if they are the right age.

B.why: You kept the league but dropped the age range. League members younger than 14 or older than 17 were never in the pool the sample was drawn from.

D.why: You went the wrong way and stopped at the sample. The swimmers were selected at random from a larger group, and random selection is exactly what lets the results speak for that whole group.

choices: Only the 40 studio members who volunteered
All members of the community printmaking studio
All printmakers who dry linocut prints
Members of any community printmaking studio
explanation: The random step in this study was assignment: it decided which volunteers used which drying method. That supports a conclusion about cause, but only for the people in the study. Nobody was randomly selected from the studio's membership, because the members chose themselves. So the results reach only the 40 volunteers.

B.why: You dropped the word 'volunteered'. The 40 members were not randomly selected from the studio. Random assignment to drying methods doesn't make them stand for every member.

C.why: You generalized to every printmaker who makes linocuts. The study only included volunteers from one studio, and none of them were randomly selected from that wider group.

D.why: You stretched the results to other studios. Only one studio took part, and even its members were not randomly selected.

All patients registered at community clinics in Dorrance County
All adults aged 18 to 30 in the country
explanation: The sample was drawn at random from one exact group: patients aged 18 to 30 registered at community clinics in Dorrance County.
